_comment: Where `budget upload|publish|rollback|status --environment NAME` sends its requests (docs/release.md, „Среди“). There is no default: every command names its environment. url null means the environment is not provisioned yet (it needs the Cloudflare account, docs/approach-specification.md, section 12).

local.note: npx wrangler dev, with the local D1 and R2 of .wrangler/state

staging.note: the staging Worker; set its address when the environment is provisioned

production.note: production; only through the documented production procedure
